_purpose: Known data issues: the caveat is attached to answers that read an affected table. {placeholders} are measured by the build.

issues.title: Synthetic data
issues.caveat: These figures come from a synthetic proof-of-concept dataset that mirrors the portal; they are not official records.

issues.title: Partial current year
issues.caveat: FY 2026-27 covers April to September 2026 only, and year-end book closure for it has not happened yet, so its year totals are part-year.

issues.title: Finance daily vs monthly closure
issues.caveat: Day-book closure (daily, by taluk) and month-end closure (by GP) come from separate tables and can disagree for the same taluk and month; the figure shown is from the table named in the answer.

issues.title: Salary bills at taluk level only
issues.caveat: Salary bills are held at taluk level only, so they cannot be broken down by GP.

issues.title: Salary bills start Jan 2022
issues.caveat: Salary-bill months run from January 2022 (FY 2021-22); Finance and Revenue start in April 2022.

issues.title: Reassigned GPs
issues.caveat: {reassigned_gps} GPs now sit in a different taluk from the one their LGD code shows (they were moved when taluks were reorganised); the taluk shown is the current one.

issues.title: HRMS rebuilt on the master geography
issues.caveat: HR figures were rebuilt on the same GP master as Finance and Revenue; some GP staff profiles were copied from a neighbouring GP of the same taluk.

issues.title: Staff never approved
issues.caveat: {not_active_staff} registered staff are 'Not Active' because they were rejected by, or are still pending at, the EO; they are not counted as active staff.

issues.title: Not every GP keeps every scheme
issues.caveat: Not every GP keeps every scheme account (for example Bapuji Seva Kendra exists in {bapuji_gps} GPs), so scheme-wise GP counts differ.

issues.title: Demand statistics rescaled
issues.caveat: Property-type figures were rescaled at build time so that, for every GP and year, they add up exactly to the DCB register.
